extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: open phone booth 1.06 x 1.06 x 2.30 m, 60 mm aluminium corner posts, 8 mm toughened glass, card phone housing 0.24 x 0.15 x 0.47 m at 1.03-1.50 m, shelf at 0.94 m
extras.notes: Generic modern booth, no operator branding: only a neutral handset pictogram on four backlit fascia panels. Open front, glass on both sides and beside the steel back column, bird-safety frit band. Phone with display, 12 stainless keys, card slot, handset in a recessed cradle and a stainless armoured cord. Glass, sign panels and downlight keep their own materials (not baked).

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
